description: This source file defines the PCSClient class in the AWS\PCS namespace, which is used to interact with the AWS Parallel Computing Service API. It includes method annotations for AWS operations related to clusters, compute nodes, queues, and resource tagging, both sync and async versions.

classes.name: PCSClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS Parallel Computing Service, extending the base AwsClient class.

methods.name: createCluster
methods.description: Creates a new compute cluster in the AWS Parallel Computing Service.

methods.name: createClusterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new compute cluster.

methods.name: createComputeNodeGroup
methods.description: Creates a compute node group within a cluster.

methods.name: createComputeNodeGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a compute node group.

methods.name: createQueueAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new job queue.

methods.name: deleteComputeNodeGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a compute node group.

methods.name: getCluster
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific cluster.

methods.name: getComputeNodeGroup
methods.description: Retrieves details about a compute node group.

methods.name: getComputeNodeGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves compute node group details.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a specific resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: registerComputeNodeGroupInstance
methods.description: Registers an instance to a compute node group.

methods.name: updateComputeNodeGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a compute node group.
